# Starboard

> Starboard is a lightweight home-server dashboard and installer, with a read-only API at /api/v1 and plug-ins that run in locked-down containers. These are its developer pages, for plug-in API 1.20 (the Starboard release after 0.24.0 and later).

<!-- plugin-api: 1.20 -->

## Plug-ins

- [Make your first plug-in](developers/make-a-plugin.md): a tutorial that builds, tests and adds a tiny plug-in with one stat card.
- [Plug-in manifest reference](developers/plugin-manifest-reference.md): every field of starboard-plugin.json, its check and the security rules, with containers built from a zip file, Jellyfin libraries and the holding folder in the media folder (plug-in API 1.15) and the requires tag (plug-in API 1.19).
- [Plug-in API reference](developers/plugin-api-reference.md): what Starboard calls on a plug-in (cards, actions, custom settings, events, jobs) and what a plug-in may call, with the disk.changed event and STARBOARD_HOME_ADDRESS (plug-in API 1.16), and sparkline cards and sending alerts (plug-in API 1.17).
- [Test and publish a plug-in](developers/test-and-publish-a-plugin.md): the plug-in tester, pinning images by digest, and writing a catalogue.json.
- [Write a plug-in that updates safely](developers/update-a-plugin-safely.md): settings migrations, a step before and after an update, the health wait with an automatic Roll back, and What is new before and after (plug-in API 1.14).
- [Write a plug-in](basics/write-a-plugin.md): the overview, with styles and dashboard cards.
- [App plug-ins](developers/plugin-manifest-reference.md#app-plug-ins): a whole app made by others, such as Seerr, with its own web page on the home network (network:port, publish, host_port, tmpfs, pids, adopt).
- [Update a plug-in and roll it back](topics/update-a-plugin.md): what happens when people update a plug-in, the automatic Roll back, and What is new.
- [Built from a zip file](developers/plugin-manifest-reference.md#built-from-a-zip-file): a private plug-in with no registry, its image built by Starboard from the Dockerfile in its zip, with the build's limits (plug-in API 1.15) and the requires tag (plug-in API 1.19).
- [Jellyfin libraries](developers/plugin-manifest-reference.md#jellyfin-libraries): libraries Starboard adds to Jellyfin for folders a plug-in fills, with jellyfin:libraries (plug-in API 1.15) and the requires tag (plug-in API 1.19).
- [The holding folder in the media folder](developers/plugin-manifest-reference.md#the-holding-folder-in-the-media-folder): library:holding, moving films and series aside and putting them back with Put back, never deleting (plug-in API 1.15) and the requires tag (plug-in API 1.19).
- [A title for each card size](developers/plugin-manifest-reference.md#a-title-for-each-size-api-115): titles on a card, one for each size, each short enough for one line in that size (plug-in API 1.15) and the requires tag (plug-in API 1.19).
- [The card band and refresh times](developers/plugin-api-reference.md#the-card-band-api-114): status, status_label, updated and refresh_seconds on every card (plug-in API 1.14).
- [The plug-ins help centre](https://themightytrex.github.io/starboard-plugins/help/): every plug-in in the collection explained, a card plug-in, an app plug-in and a converter (Direct play) among them, with Direct play's card worked through.

## Starboard's API

- [API quickstart](developers/api-quickstart.md): make a key and make a first call with curl or Python, with paging and ETags.
- [Authentication and keys](developers/api-authentication.md): keys, scopes (Logs and Updates only when ticked), expiry, revoking, rate limits and the audit log.
- [MCP tools](developers/mcp-tools.md): POST /api/v1/mcp, the Model Context Protocol for AI assistants: read-only tools for the Library, downloads, requests, app health and disk space, off until the owner activates it, with a Read only key (API 1.7.0).
- [API reference](developers/api-reference.md): every address in version 1, generated from openapi.json.
- [List of API errors](../api/errors.md): each problem code, its cause and its fix.
- [API changelog](developers/api-changelog.md): what each version of the API and the plug-in API added.

## Optional

- [All the developer pages in one file](llms-full.txt): the API and plug-in pages above in full, for tools that read one file, made from the pages by tools/make_llms_full.py.
- [AI prompts for developers](developers/ai-prompts-for-developers.md): copy-ready prompts for a card plug-in, an app plug-in and a plug-in that converts files, each with the checklist the assistant must follow, and for scripts that use the API.
- [OpenAPI description](../../starboard/openapi.json): the machine-readable API description, also served at /api/v1/openapi.json.
- [Plug-in manifest JSON Schema](../../starboard/plugin-manifest.schema.json): the manifest's rules for editors and tools.
